nodes.name: incandescence-heal-received.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test guarding the Incandescence Destiny fix: its Heal_Dmg/aspect=Resistance effect must surface as a 'Healing Received' character total instead of being flattened into damage resistance.

nodes.name: incarnate-effects-completeness.test.ts
nodes.summary: Completeness guard for the incarnate effects pipeline: verifies Destiny/Hybrid/Clarion effect categories (mez protection, heal, endurance) all reach character totals instead of being silently dropped by converter allowlists.

nodes.name: incarnate-exemplar.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests that incarnate power effects are suppressed from character totals when the effective (exemplar) level drops below the incarnate minimum level.

nodes.name: inherents.ts
nodes.summary: Implements archetype inherent mechanics for every AT: Defiance, Domination, Scourge, Fury, Supremacy/Bodyguard, Vigilance, Opportunity, Critical Hit, Assassination, Gauntlet, and Containment, each with info descriptors, damage/chance calculators, and power-eligibility predicates.
nodes.languageNotes: Organized as one section per archetype, each exposing an info getter, numeric calculators, and an is*Power eligibility predicate.

nodes.name: calculateAreaModifier
nodes.summary: Computes the AoE area factor modifier (radius/arc based) used to scale inherent damage contributions for area attacks.

nodes.name: calculateDefiance
nodes.summary: Calculates the Blaster Defiance damage bonus from recently used attacks, weighting each power's contribution by cast time and area modifier.

nodes.name: isBlasterAttackPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies as a Blaster attack for Defiance accumulation.

nodes.name: getDominationInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Dominator Domination inherent (fury-style bar, mez magnitude doubling).

nodes.name: getPowerDominationSummary
nodes.summary: Summarizes how Domination modifies a specific power (doubled mez magnitude/duration when active).

nodes.name: getScourgeInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Corruptor Scourge inherent (chance for double damage scaling with target health loss).

nodes.name: calculateScourgeChance
nodes.summary: Calculates Scourge trigger chance from the target's remaining health percentage.

nodes.name: calculateScourgeDamage
nodes.summary: Calculates expected bonus damage from Scourge given base damage and trigger chance.

nodes.name: isCorruptorAttackPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies for Corruptor Scourge.

nodes.name: getFuryInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Brute Fury inherent (damage bonus building with combat activity).

nodes.name: calculateFuryDamageBonus
nodes.summary: Converts a Fury bar level into its percentage damage bonus.

nodes.name: calculateFuryDamage
nodes.summary: Applies the Fury damage bonus to a base damage value.

nodes.name: isBruteAttackPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies as a Brute attack for Fury.

nodes.name: getSupremacyInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Mastermind Supremacy inherent (pet damage/to-hit buffs in supremacy range).

nodes.name: getBodyguardInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for Mastermind Bodyguard mode (damage sharing across pets).

nodes.name: calculateSupremacyDamage
nodes.summary: Applies the Supremacy damage buff to pet base damage.

nodes.name: calculateSupremacyToHit
nodes.summary: Applies the Supremacy to-hit buff for pets.

nodes.name: calculateBodyguardDamage
nodes.summary: Calculates damage taken by the Mastermind in Bodyguard mode, splitting incoming damage across bodyguard-mode pets.

nodes.name: isMastermindPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power belongs to Mastermind inherent handling.

nodes.name: getVigilanceInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Defender Vigilance inherent (endurance discount from ally health, solo damage bonus).

nodes.name: calculateVigilanceDamageBonus
nodes.summary: Calculates the Vigilance solo/small-team damage bonus based on team size.

nodes.name: calculateVigilanceDamage
nodes.summary: Applies the Vigilance damage bonus to base damage.

nodes.name: isDefenderPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies for Defender Vigilance handling.

nodes.name: getOpportunityInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Sentinel Opportunity inherent (vulnerability debuff and heal/endurance returns).

nodes.name: isSentinelPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power belongs to Sentinel inherent handling.

nodes.name: getCriticalHitInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Scrapper Critical Hit inherent (crit chance vs minions/lieutenants and bosses).

nodes.name: calculateCriticalHitChance
nodes.summary: Returns the Scrapper crit chance for a given target rank.

nodes.name: calculateCriticalHitDamage
nodes.summary: Calculates expected bonus damage from Scrapper critical hits.

nodes.name: isScrapperAttackPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies for Scrapper critical hits.

nodes.name: getOpportunityCritBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the Sentinel Opportunity crit damage multiplier constant.

nodes.name: calculateOpportunityCritDamage
nodes.summary: Calculates bonus damage from Sentinel Opportunity crits.

nodes.name: isSentinelAttackPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies as a Sentinel attack.

nodes.name: getAssassinationInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Stalker Assassination inherent (hidden crits, Assassin Focus stacks).

nodes.name: calculateAssassinationCritChance
nodes.summary: Calculates Stalker crit chance from hidden status, team size, and Assassin Focus stacks.

nodes.name: calculateAssassinationDamageBonus
nodes.summary: Calculates the expected damage bonus multiplier from Assassination crit mechanics.

nodes.name: calculateAssassinationDamage
nodes.summary: Applies Assassination crit expectations to base damage.

nodes.name: isStalkerAttackPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies for Stalker Assassination mechanics.

nodes.name: getGauntletInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Tanker Gauntlet inherent (taunt on attack, widened AoEs).

nodes.name: calculateGauntletRadius
nodes.summary: Calculates the Gauntlet-boosted AoE radius for Tanker attacks.

nodes.name: calculateGauntletArc
nodes.summary: Calculates the Gauntlet-boosted cone arc for Tanker attacks.

nodes.name: isTankerPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies for Tanker Gauntlet handling.

nodes.name: getContainmentInfo
nodes.summary: Returns descriptor info for the Controller Containment inherent (double damage vs mezzed targets).

nodes.name: calculateContainmentDamageBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the Containment damage bonus multiplier when the target is mezzed.

nodes.name: calculateContainmentDamage
nodes.summary: Applies the Containment bonus to base damage against contained targets.

nodes.name: isControllerPower
nodes.summary: Predicate: whether a power qualifies for Controller Containment.

nodes.name: jump-height.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests jump-height character totals against movement-constant bases and caps, guarding the jump buff support added with the travel-speed fixes.

nodes.name: perma.ts
nodes.summary: Determines whether a click power can be made "perma" (buff duration >= enhanced recharge + cast time) and computes uptime/gap info, including detection of self-state buffs worth keeping up.

nodes.name: isPermaEligible
nodes.summary: Decides whether a power is a candidate for perma analysis (click power with a lasting self-state buff and meaningful recharge).

nodes.name: hasSelfStateToKeepUp
nodes.summary: Scans a power's effects for self-directed lasting buffs (defense, resistance, mez protection, etc.) that justify keeping the power permanently active.

nodes.name: calculatePermaInfo
nodes.summary: Computes perma status for a power: enhanced recharge vs buff duration, uptime percentage, and the recharge still needed to reach perma.

nodes.name: proc-global-damage.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests the Liberty's Belt fused +7.5% global Damage proc: slotting the piece must raise the character damage total via the always-on global proc path.

nodes.name: proc-global-recharge.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests Luck of the Gambler style global +recharge procs: slotting the piece must contribute its recharge bonus to character totals with Rule-of-5 handling.

nodes.name: proc-runtime-allowlist.test.ts
nodes.summary: Guards the runtime allowlist of proc effect categories: only recognized always-on global proc categories may flow into character totals, preventing unhandled categories from silently applying.

nodes.name: buildWithSlots
nodes.summary: Test fixture: constructs a build with a slotted power containing the supplied enhancement slots.

nodes.name: proc-variable-calc.test.ts
nodes.summary: Tests variable/stacking proc contributions (e.g. Might of the Tanker absorb stacks, Interface-style scaling) so per-stack overrides and interpolated values reach character totals correctly.

nodes.name: tankerBuild
nodes.summary: Test fixture: constructs a Tanker build with proc-slotted powers used across the variable-proc test cases.

nodes.name: self-penalty-towho.test.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies converter output for self-directed penalties: effects like Bio Armor Offensive Adaptation's -resistance must carry toWho:Self so they are charged to the caster rather than treated as foe debuffs.
